verdict.rationale: Secureframe publishes a Trust Center where admins choose to hide or display content (docs-14, docs-49). Separately, the platform keeps the vendor list current through SSO-based detection (docs-11) and monitors control status daily (docs-12). No evidence shows that the Trust Center itself pulls subprocessor lists, document renewals, or control status from the platform automatically rather than through manual admin curation. Missing for 10: documented auto-sync of subprocessor/vendor lists to the Trust Center, automatic document renewal/expiry updates, live control-status publishing on the Trust Center, and independent corroboration.
